Vinícius Wilbert Hack (Vinícius Hack) is a software engineer, developer and programmer based in Balneário Camboriú, Santa Catarina, Brazil. He has been a hired developer since 2021 (programming since 2019) and, on the side, builds his own apps and apps for clients.

## Work

- Automatize: AI agent so a non-technical client can create, pause and read paid-traffic campaigns in the app and WhatsApp
- Layback Trading: white-label trading platform (100k+ users/day), NestJS APIs and Rust bot engine
- MyTribe: iOS/Android social app
- Alento Foto & Filme: wedding photography site plus a gallery delivery system (admin panel, private client galleries, streamed downloads), freelance from scratch to paying clients · https://viniciushack.com/projetos/alento
- Ritmo: native Mac + iPhone app that tracks time on its own and confronts what you do with your priorities · https://viniciushack.com/projetos/ritmo
- Lume: Mac + iPhone agent that compares what you said you'd do with what you're doing and intervenes in time · https://viniciushack.com/projetos/lume
- Finance Hub: finance aggregator with Open Finance and an AI-written monthly reading · https://viniciushack.com/projetos/finance-hub
- Goalfy: Stripe payments and react-flow diagrams

## Location

Balneário Camboriú, Santa Catarina, Brazil. Languages: Portuguese and English.
